english.title: Gross indecency between man aged 16 or 17 and boy under 16
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a man aged **(..SPECIFY WHETHER 16 OR 17..) years, committed an act of gross indecency with **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a man under the age of 16, namely the age of **(..SPECIFY AGE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13 of and Schedule 2 to the Sexual Offences Act 1956.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE

(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required for prosecution of indecency between males where at least one is under the age of 16.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H2310 where the offender is aged 16 or 17 - maximum two years imprisonment and H2311 where the offender is aged over 21 - maximum five years imprisonment.
(iii) Prosecution may not be commenced more than twelve months after the offence.
(v) As amended by the Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2000.
(v) This offence is included in Schedule 1 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must comply with the requirements of section 2 of that Act.
(vi) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003
